original_metadata.name: 行业趋势与机会分析
original_metadata.description: 分析行业或岗位方向的发展趋势、机会点、风险点、适合人群和切入建议。
preconditions: 用户已提出相关职业发展请求，或上一步 action 已产生可用上下文
postconditions: 产生可进入下一步 action 的 state_update 或 intermediate_artifact

compiled_metadata.summary: Analyzes industry or role-area trends, opportunities, risks, suitable profiles, and entry suggestions.
trigger_examples: Analyze opportunities in the AI healthcare industry.
What are the trends, risks, and entry roles in fintech?
Is sustainability consulting a good direction now?
negative_trigger_examples: Choose my primary role from these options.
Explain daily tasks of a data analyst.

handoff_conditions.target_role_positioning: Use when the user wants to select target roles from the opportunity analysis.
handoff_conditions.career_risk_assessment: Use when the user wants detailed risk evaluation for a career move.
handoff_conditions.application_strategy_planning: Use when the user is ready to apply into the industry or roles.
